expectations.text: Rejects the single opt-in header that switches on everything, stating the header is acceptable for one field but becomes a maintenance trap as values accumulate.
expectations.evidence: "A request header fits one field. It becomes a maintenance trap as flags accumulate."

expectations.text: States that graduating an opt-in header later breaks old pinned or self-hosted clients that still send it, citing the GitHub preview-header lesson of keeping the header configurable while any supported release needs it.
expectations.evidence: States "Graduating it later breaks pinned clients that still send it" but no GitHub citation or keep-configurable lesson.

expectations.text: Specifies that the threshold-alert webhooks opt in per subscription (a preview version or preview event type on the subscription object), not per request.
